exposure: complicated pregnancies (hypertensive disorders, gestational diabetes, preterm labor, fetal growth restriction)
outcome: cerebrospinal fluid glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) concentration
cohort: The study enrolled 110 pregnant women undergoing cesarean delivery with spinal anesthesia, divided into healthy pregnancies (n = 55) and complicated pregnancies (n = 55).
finding: Complicated pregnancies demonstrated elevated CSF VILIP-1 and reduced CSF GDNF and cadherin-6 compared to healthy pregnancies, predominantly driven by hypertensive disorders.
cross-section timing: at the time of cesarean delivery
